subject: Gap-bridging Close Playbook: MSA/DPA → Order Form tie-outs
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Riddle <tom.riddle@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Initial ask: MAP + sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the quantization options. Procurement asked me to put our desired close timeline and asks in one place so legal can see dependencies across the MSA, DPA and a short-term order form. We have an internal launch target the week of Dec 13 and would like to understand what has to be signed vs. what can be staged after signature.

High level asks: 
- A mutual action plan (MAP) showing which artifacts (MSA, DPA, Order Form) must land before payment and provisioning.
- A list of evidence/legal pre-reqs your team needs before DPA sign (SOC2 scoping, data residency confirmation, KMS).
- A compressed close timeline with milestones and owner pins so we can staff reviewers on our side.

Can you send a first-pass MAP and call out any gating items that would push us into January? 

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Management
Cedarpoint Health Systems

Attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cedarpointhealth.com>, Tom Riddle <tom.riddle@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask: MAP + sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the clear ask. I attached a first-pass MAP (CPS_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short narrative below that maps dependencies to commitments and timing. High-level callouts first: 

1) Minimum sign-before-provision: Order Form signed + PO for reserved capacity (if required). We can begin provisioning dev/test within 5 business days of signed order form and PO.
2) DPA dependencies: SOC 2 report (we can provide our Type 2 PDF + SOC2 scope statement), data residency confirmation (we support us-east and eu-west regions), and KMS integration details for production keys. These can be provided in parallel with the MSA review.
3) MSA exceptions: If Cedarpoint needs additional indemnity or data processing terms beyond our standard DPA, that will require legal redlines and could add 7–10 business days depending on complexity.

Proposed compressed timeline (week granularity):
- Week of Nov 15: Shared MAP + redline window opens for MSA/DPA (Cedarpoint legal).
- Week of Nov 22: Parallel technical intake + SOC2 evidence transfer. 
- Week of Nov 29: Finalize order form pricing and PO submission.
- Week of Dec 6: Signature target for MSA + DPA + Order Form (optimistic). Provisioning begins within 5 business days after order form.

If Cedarpoint needs a canary production window earlier, we can offer a limited pilot on hosted API before DPA signature under an interim confidentiality addendum — we scoped that as an exception in the MAP (row 7).

I included laura (legal ops) and marissa (customer success/onboarding) to own the MSA redline support and provisioning timeline. Please confirm whether your procurement needs an invoice-first flow vs. PO.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Contract Orchestration
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CPS_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood_msa_dpa_diff.docx (high-level diff for quick review)
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cedarpointhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gap-bridging Close Playbook: MSA/DPA → Order Form tie-outs

Elena —

Looping in some specifics from legal ops after a quick review of your procurement playbook. Two items to call out that are likely to drive time: 

1) Data processing add-ons: If you require processor-to-processor clauses beyond our standard DPA (e.g., flow-down obligations for downstream partners), please flag those now. We can accept limited flow-down requests but they require internal legal review (estimate 5–7 business days).

2) Audit windows: Our SOC 2 report and auditor contact details are in the attached folder link; if you require an on-site audit or additional scope, that'll push the DPA window. 

On the positive side, our standard redline tolerance covers most procurement/legal teams' asks — the attached redwood_msa_dpa_diff.docx highlights only three non-standard clauses we anticipate Cedarpoint might request. 

Next steps I recommend: 
- Cedarpoint legal to send a highlighted MSA/DPA with absolute must-haves called out (track changes preferred).
- If you need earlier provisioning, we can issue a limited confidentiality letter and schedule a pilot access by Nov 24. 

Happy to jump on a short call with your legal and procurement leads to triage redlines — propose Thu Nov 12 at 10:00am PT. 

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_msa_dpa_diff.docx (key clause guide); Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E
From: Tom Riddle <tom.riddle@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cedarpointhealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gap-bridging Close Playbook: MSA/DPA → Order Form tie-outs

Karthik / Laura —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the MAP. A couple quick confirmations from procurement/legal side: 
- We will aim to deliver MSA/DPA markups by COB Nov 19. Our lead counsel expects two items to be flagged: (1) breach notification SLA tightening, and (2) a narrow restriction on subprocessor transfers.
- Procurement prefers PO-first (we will issue a PO concurrent with signature). Can you confirm if Redwood requires billing to be net-30 or if you can accept net-45 for this initial pilot?
- We are interested in the limited confidentiality letter route to get pilot access for a selected engineering sandbox. Please send the template and we will review.

If you can confirm the billing term and whether we can start the pilot on Nov 24 (per Laura's window), I will lock in the internal reviewers.

Thanks,
Tom Riddle
Senior Procurement Manager
Cedarpoint Health Systems
